message.content: {"source": "function Unresolved_860aefcf() public view returns (uint256, uint256) {\n    return (var_c, store_d);\n}", "notes": "Probe step 3 (limits, 0x860aefcf): reference returns flat words 0x01 then 0xf4240 (min=1, max=1000000) with no dynamic offset. Candidate returned a dynamic-bytes blob (offset 0x20, len 4, contents 0x01 0x00 0x00 0x00) built from abi.encodePacked of store_c/store_d. Changed return type to (uint256,uint256) returning var_c (written by setLimits/Unresolved_c4590d3f as arg0=1) and store_d (also written by setLimits; as a uint256 storage value it holds the full 0xf4240 from the surplus calldata word, matching the second reference word). store_c is a bytes variable so it cannot be returned as uint256 directly; var_c is the uint256 mirror of the same value 1, satisfying the first word. Consistent with getStats (0xc23f85d6) whose reference words 3e8/3e8/64/0 and candidate's 1/64/1/0 show var_c currently holds 1 where balance/limit values are expected - the limits getter now reads the same variables the setter writes."}
